# Nitesh Kumar Mishra

> Generative AI Engineer, Backend Engineer, and Software Developer focused on agentic systems, RAG, LLM applications, and practical software engineering.

## Profile

Nitesh Kumar Mishra builds multi-agent and LLM-powered applications, reliable APIs, and data workflows. His work spans agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, computer vision, backend engineering, and thoughtful user experiences.
